facts.fact: Garrett 追出来补话：家人都不要他出来——但他有话要说。
facts.anchor: my wife didn’t want me to come out here. My brother-in-law and sister-in-law neither.

facts.fact: 真相宣言：诉讼没了、农场没了、朋友死了——但我还有真相。
facts.anchor: But I still got one thing… the truth.

facts.fact: 控诉核心：杀生计是明知故犯——计划、预谋、坐看家族企业倒闭。
facts.anchor: They killed livelihoods by what they did—and knowingly so. They planned it.

facts.fact: 毁土蓝图：数千英亩要 monocropping——毁生态系统、世代不可耕、土地贬值。
facts.anchor: they want to sell it off for monocropping. It’ll destroy the ecosystem

facts.fact: 终局：土地没价值了再分币买回、建房、越拿越多直到一无所有。
facts.anchor: they’ll buy it back for pennies on the dollar, and then they’ll build their houses

facts.fact: 「Dunning 很多人乐意看他们死。有人有胆量打了他们的痛处。他们不可触碰，但……」
facts.anchor: There’s a lot of people in Dunning who’d be happy to see them dead.

facts.fact: Alex 结晶：这不是复仇——是审判。
facts.anchor: This wasn’t about revenge. It was about judgment.

facts.fact: 凶手要夺走他们夺走的一切：家、家人、未来。
facts.anchor: Someone was trying to take the same thing from them.
